derivation: Renewal eligibility holds, so evaluation reaches current authority. AUTH-005 requires current revocation checks for every selected act, and a revoked observation cannot establish permission, so the evaluator returns AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED with sole reason REVOKED. LIFE-007 maps that to an admitted policy withholding whose sorted reason codes are the union of AUTHORITY_REQUIRED, the refusal code and every refusal reason. The authority withholding records an empty reservation-receipt array, a null permit digest and the prior permit digest, and the reservation transition is never reached, so the registry is unchanged and the prior permit is not superseded.
